name: qwatt-site
description: QWATT — static site plus the verification protocol (protocol/). No build step for the site; `npm run gen:gates` regenerates the gate bindings from protocol/gates.spec.json, `npm test` runs the conformance and validator suites with no install. npm install is only needed to vendor the wallet dependencies (see scripts/build-wallet-vendor.md).

scripts.test: node protocol/gen.js --check && node protocol/conformance.test.js && node mining-rig/validators.test.js && node ingest/ingest.test.js && node batch/batch.test.js && node batch/reconcile.test.js && node live/live.test.js && node ops/watch.test.js && node ops/publish-feed.test.js && node ops/writeup.test.js && node ops/keys-policy.test.js && node ops/site-sync.js --check && node ops/site.test.js && node ops/site-live.test.js && node protocol/build-browser.js --check && node ops/sample-feeds.js --check && node ops/protocol-browser.test.js && node ops/site-evidence.test.js
scripts.test:anchor: node anchor/tx.test.js && node anchor/recovery.test.js && node anchor/tests-abcd.test.js && node anchor/keys.test.js
scripts.test:site: node ops/site-sync.js --check && node ops/site.test.js && node ops/site-live.test.js
scripts.test:compruebalo: node protocol/build-browser.js --check && node ops/sample-feeds.js --check && node ops/protocol-browser.test.js && node ops/site-evidence.test.js
